name: Jergosh the Invoker
summary: Beneath Orgrimmar, Jergosh the Invoker leads a cult against the Horde. In Ragefire Chasm, he turns to demonic arts while Thrall guides the orcs toward honor and shamanism.

sections.title: A Cult Beneath the City
sections.body: Jergosh gathers the Searing Blade beneath Orgrimmar. Thrall leads the orcs toward honor and shamanism, but Jergosh turns to demonic power. In Ragefire Chasm, he draws followers into a sect aligned with the remnants of the Shadow Council. From beneath the Horde capital, the cult works against the path the new Horde has chosen.

sections.title: Demonic Ambitions
sections.body: Jergosh's work in Ragefire Chasm has drawn Thrall's direct scrutiny. Dark rituals and dangerous schemes have grown bold enough to catch the Warchief's attention. Within Durotar, Jergosh keeps the dark pacts alive, though the Horde fought to leave them behind.

faq.answer: Jergosh the Invoker leads the Searing Blade cultists in Ragefire Chasm. He rejects Thrall's honorable path and embraces demonic sorcery.

faq.q: Why is Jergosh hiding in Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: Jergosh hides beneath Orgrimmar in Ragefire Chasm. There, the Searing Blade can practice dark magic and conspire against the Horde.

faq.q: What faction does Jergosh belong to?
faq.answer: Jergosh leads the Searing Blade, a cult linked to the Shadow Council. Its members serve demonic interests like the Burning Legion.

faq.q: Does Thrall know Jergosh is beneath Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Yes. Jergosh's plots grew dangerous enough to reach Thrall. The Warchief sent trusted adventurers into Ragefire Chasm to stop the cultists.

faq.q: Why does Jergosh practice fel magic instead of shamanism?
faq.answer: Jergosh rejects shamanistic harmony and turns to demonic sorcery. He seeks the power of the Burning Legion and the dark arts.

angles.text: As an orc, you can see Jergosh's service to the old Horde's lingering pull toward demonic blood and sorcery. Thrall seeks to purge that legacy from orcish culture.
As a warlock, you face a powerful practitioner of the demonic arts. His schemes threaten the Horde.
A Shadow Council cell beneath the chieftain's throne room threatens the Horde's security.
